regime_context: The US thematic detector shows a broad (31/49 eligible) but non-directional rotation with Memory/HBM & Storage as the leader (score 2.265, eligible, not crowded but durability_bar only 0.51 and val_state 'fading'), closely challenged by Silver Miners (1.915, durability 0.78, full breadth). The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech and geopolitics headlines with 99% unscheduled share — coincident context, not a trigger. Track record shows 63% call hit-rate but only 43% directional accuracy, so conviction should default low.
emerging_watch: Watch Silver Miners as a confirmed-leadership handoff candidate: if SIL's score closes the 0.35 margin to Memory/HBM within the next 10 trading days AND Memory/HBM's durability_bar drops below 0.45, the handoff condition would be met. This is a watch, not a call.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners combine the strongest structural legs the detector actually offers: high durability_bar (0.78), full breadth (1.0) meaning every constituent is participating, eligible under the absolute-trend gate, and not crowded. Its rank (2nd) and score (1.915) are a focus lens only, but the trend-gate eligibility plus breadth cohesion argues the theme is durable rather than a one-name spike. Momentum rank is NOT the reason — the staying-power legs are.
theses.dissent: Silver miners are a high-beta, sentiment-driven complex; the headline leader (Memory/HBM) is fading and a broad risk-off would hit miners harder than the more defensive Gold Miners. The detector's own momentum rank has ~0 forward IC, so '2nd place' carries no predictive edge.

falsifier.text: SIL lags GDX by 8% over the next 30 trading days while both are above their trend gates

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners show the cleanest trend-health signature of the top-ranked names: durability_bar 0.80, hurst_tag 'trend' (not mixed), full breadth 1.0, eligible, and not crowded. This is a trend-following, vol-aware lean grounded in the one validated detector leg (absolute-trend gate) rather than momentum rank. The 'trend' hurst tag distinguishes it from the 'mixed' leader.
theses.dissent: Real yields and USD strength are the dominant macro drivers for gold miners and are unknowable from this state; a hawkish surprise would break the trend regardless of internal breadth. Small-sample track record (49 calls) does not support high conviction.

falsifier.text: GDX closes below its own 50-day average while the broader market stays above its trend gate within the next 30 days

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is crowded (crowding_z=1.93, crowded=true) which is a size-down caution — not a fade, never a short. The theme is eligible and has strong durability (0.86) and trend-tag, but the crowding flag plus a modest score (0.887, rank 5) argues for not adding new exposure here. This is expressed as 'avoid' i.e. no new lean, consistent with the guardrail against treating crowding as a sell.
theses.dissent: Crowding has no basket-level forward edge and a crowded trend can persist for long stretches; avoiding it may simply mean missing continuation. The only valid read is to not SIZE UP, not to underweight.

falsifier.text: CIBR not crowded (crowding_z below 1.0) and durability_bar holds above 0.80 through the next 21 days
